مِكَرٌّ One who returns often [to the fight, after wheeling away, or retiring, or being put to flight]; as also ↓ كَرَّارٌ . (K) ―
-b2- فَرَسٌ مِكَرٌّ A horse that is suitable, or fit, for returning to the fight, and for charging, or assaulting. (S.) And فَرَسٌ مِكَرٌّ مِفَرٌّ A horse well trained, willing, and active, ready to return to the fight and to flee. (TA.) ―
-b3- نَاقَةٌ مِكَرَّةٌ A she-camel that is milked twice every day. (A, Sgh, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
